author: IGN
description: Sundance Award-winning comedy, The Incomer is a modern folk fairy tale set on a remote Scottish island, where two siblings survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded Incomers'. Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland on behalf of the government.
title: The Incomer - Official Trailer (2026) Domhnall Gleeson, Gayle Rankin

author: IGN
description: Isabel, a 17-year-old from the rural north of the Philippines, works at a posh country club outside Manila. Amid stifling heat and pervasive drought, she lines up golf balls for powerful men to drive into the carefully manicured verdant horizon. Between shifts, she wanders the immaculate grounds, sampling its luxuries and exploring its liminal spaces. The club’s members, including an industrialist and his expatriate niece, the president and his pampered wife, and a slew of Chinese tourists, engage in a complex dance with the doting and subservient staff. But something is rotting beneath the pristine fairways of the elite resort, as Isabel discovers when she tries to return a mislaid golf club to its patriarchal director, Dr. Palanca. The deeper she journeys into its most exclusive corners, the closer she gets to the violent truths of the club, her native Philippines, and her own past. Executive produced by Jia Zhangke, this Sundance award-winning debut announces writer-director Rafael
title: Filipinana - Official Trailer (2026)

author: IGN
description:

author: IGN
description: Ever wondered who played Lae'zel in Baldur's Gate 3, or who played Clea in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33? Turns out they're both Devora Wilde, who joins us to revisit all her greatest video game performances so far, including roles in games such as Cyperpunk 2007, Split Fiction, Cronos: The New Dawn, and so much more!
title: Devora Wilde Revisits Her Greatest Video Game Performances

description:

author: IGN
description: Check out the Early Access Launch Trailer for EverRail, an open-world base-building survival crafting game developed by Aesir Interactive. Players will take on enemies, scavenge for resources, and endure the brutal conditions of the Inara, a train that never stops. Upgrade the train and survive with friends in co-op in EverRail, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: EverRail - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Step into the world of Forgotten Station in this announcement trailer for this upcoming single-player, narrative, knowledge-based game in which you embody a lost traveler trapped in a time loop. To escape, you must navigate a mysterious train network, meet memorable characters with stories of their own, while gradually uncovering the rules of this strange world. Forgotten Station will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Forgotten Station - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: It started in your foot. Now it’s in your head. All that remains is the command: GO UP. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every ascent teaches you what you should have done differently. Watch the unsettling Moldrise launch trailer for this psychological horror game. Moldrise is available now on Steam.
title: Moldrise - Official Launch Trailer
